tools.name: untrusted-instruction-detector
tools.description: Tool results and fetched pages can hide ignore-previous-instructions text or a fake system prompt, and an agent that follows them will treat untrusted text as a new policy. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Detects override attempts, hidden markup, and prompt-exfil requests in caller-supplied t

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "untrusted-instruction-detector" stacks urgency/override words (ignore, override, bypass). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
